gig.title: And So I Watch You From Afar & Caspian
gig.pageText: And So I Watch You From Afar & Caspian - Electric Ballroom facebook twitter close menu instagram Home What’s On Gallery FAQ’S 184 CAMDEN HIGH STREET, CAMDEN TOWN, LONDON, NW1 8QP See Inside And So I Watch You From Afar & Caspian ← Back PINK MIST PRESENTS: And So I Watch You From Afar & Caspian plus otay:onii And So I Watch You From Afar were born from freezing cold winters on the northernmost tip of Ireland. They play raw, charging, experimental music that is hard to define. Sometimes angular and noisy, sometimes pulsing, euphoric, overwhelming. The joy, the power, the escapism found in their live shows is fabled. In 2006, they jumped in the van and didn’t stop. Across Europe, USA, Russia, Asia, Central America, Australia, touring relentlessly, they’ve slowly built a cult following around the world. Their albums are uncompromising and exploratory. The true spirit of independence, the definition of DIY, of realness and resolve. Caspian’s majestic collision of post-rock, metal, shoegaze, electronics, noise, minimalism and ambient music is an existential meditation, an acceptance of the cyclical nature of both life and career. Their most recent record, On Circles, is an art-rock record swirling with fourth-world saxophones, dubby textures, 7/8 rhythms and hard-sawed cello from Jo Quail (Myrkyr, Winterfylleth, Poppy Ackroyd). Recorded at Studio 4 in Conshohocken, PA, by producer Will Yip (Code Orange, Defeater, Quicksand, Turnstile), it marked the most organic writing and recording sessions in Caspian’s 15-year history, and with new music on the way there is all the reasons to be very excited indeed… Lane Shi, known professionally as otay:onii, is one of the most inquisitive and genre-defying artists of her generation. A multifaceted creator whose work spans performance art, composition, installation, and avant-garde music practice. otay:onii is the first ever artist selected for the three-year Triennium Residency at Roadburn, she was a contributing composer and performer in Florentina Holzinger’s groundbreaking opera production ‘SANCTA‘, and has performed at festivals world-wide such as SXSW, Roadburn Festival, CTM, Fusion, Creepy Teepy, LGW, Fekete Zaj, and Full of Lava. gig.title: The Undertones+ Ruts DC + Tom Robinson
gig.pageText: The Undertones+ Ruts DC + Tom Robinson - Electric Ballroom facebook twitter close menu instagram Home What’s On Gallery FAQ’S 184 CAMDEN HIGH STREET, CAMDEN TOWN, LONDON, NW1 8QP See Inside The Undertones+ Ruts DC + Tom Robinson ← Back The Undertones: 50th Anniversary Show + special guest Ruts DC & Tom Robinson 2026 Sees The Undertones come roaring back with an extensive UK tour to celebrate their 50TH BAND ANNIVERSARY. The Undertones emerged from Derry, Northern Ireland in 1976, the result of five friends learning how to play basic rock and roll. Even by the standards of that decade, Derry was not the rock and roll capital of anywhere and with no live bands worth watching, they learned their trade by listening to mail order records, reading one of the few copies of NME that made it to Derry but most of all from listening to John Peel’s show on BBC Radio One. Practicing in their bedrooms eventually led to the band recording ‘Teenage Kicks’ in 1978 on Terri Hooley’s Good Vibrations label in Belfast. A copy was sent to the legendary DJ John Peel and he liked the track so much he played it twice in a row on his radio show! Live The Undertones present a glorious set of classic tracks taken from what are considered by many fans and critics to be some of the best punk albums of all time, adding to them a whole bucketful of their iconic guitar pop hits & anthems, Get Over You, Jimmy Jimmy, My Perfect Cousin, You’ve Got My Number, Julie Ocean, Wednesday Week, and, of course, Teenage Kicks. Ruts DC The Ruts DC were formed in 1981 by the rhythm section and guitarist of The Ruts. The Ruts had had three whirlwind years of success and much critical acclaim – excellent releases included the singles “Babylons Burning” ,”Jah War”,” Something That I Said” and “Staring At The Rude Boys” and the albums “The Crack”, “Grin And Bear It” and “Animal Now’. The late great John Peel at Radio 1 strongly supported the band’s debut single “In A Rut”, which was released on the label ‘People Unite’ by reggae band Misty In Roots, as they shared the common fight against racism and the National Front. They were later invited to play live for him, and their 1979 “Peel Sessions” set was eventually released as a 12-inch in 1986. Known for their dynamic, high-intensity shows, this upcoming European and UK run promises the biggest NO CIGAR experience yet — with fan favourites, deep cuts and the possibility of brand-new material making its live debut. gig.title: Sick Tamburo
gig.pageText: Sick Tamburo – Dingwalls Skip to content Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Sick Tamburo Thursday, 24 September 2026 , 19:00 £29.95 BUY NOW Sick Tamburo was born from an idea by Elisabetta Imelio and Gian Maria Accusani, previously associated with Prozac+. Elisabetta and Gian Maria chose the name Sick Tamburo, originally conceived for Gian Maria’s noise percussion project, now known as Hardcore Tamburo. Sick Tamburo began by posting a few songs on MySpace (In fumota, Finché tu sei qua, Topoallucinazione, and Quel paese) and the video for “Tocca 24/7” on YouTube, in which they appear wearing white masks to hide their faces. They decided to use nicknames: Gian Maria chose Mr. Man, while Elisabetta opted for Boom Girl. However, they were recognized and abandoned the masks, choosing balaclavas instead for aesthetic reasons. They immediately signed up to La Tempesta Dischi, a collective of independent artists led by Tre allegri ragazzi morti, also from Pordenone. Sick Tamburo’s self-titled debut album was released on April 10, 2009. The twelve songs, written and composed by Gian Maria, feature repetitive rhythms accompanied by minimalist lyrics. The artwork is by Alessandro Baronciani. Their first official single, “Il mio cane con tre zampe,” was released on April 20, 2009, marking the beginning of their collaboration with Stefano Poletti, who also directed their subsequent music videos. They received awards at the Meeting delle Etichette Indipendenti (MEI), its independent chart, and began a live tour that included festivals including La Tempesta sotto le stelle, Rivolution Fest, and the Festa di Radio Onda d’Urto. In November 2009, their second single, “Parlami per sempre,” was released, filmed in Parma’s paper dump. In October 2011, the single “E so che sai che un giorno” heralded the release of their second album, “A.I.U.T.O.” dated November 4, 2011. Its themes are summarized in the acronym “Highly Irritating Human Obsessive Techniques.” The album contains 12 tracks and the artwork is by Jacopo Lietti. The “A.I.U.T.O. Tour,” which began in Milan on November 25, takes the band across Italy. On April 28, 2014, the music video for the song “Il fiore per te” (The Flower for You) was released, a preview of the album “Senza vergogna.” Davide Toffolo of Tre allegri ragazzi morti, who also designed the album cover, appeared in the video and song. “Senza vergogna” was released on June 3, 2014, and contains ten tracks that revolve around manias, quirks, and obsessions. Things we’ve been taught to keep hidden, things that are part of all of us and therefore shouldn’t be shamed. In 2017, “Un giorno nuovo,” Sick Tamburo’s fourth album, was released on La Tempesta Dischi. Produced by Gian Maria Accusani in his studio for Discgust Music Production, it contains nine original tracks and continues the musical journey the band began in 2007, taking it to a new level with a renewed interweaving of electric guitars and synthesizers, driving rhythms, and wave melodies. The album is preceded by the title track Un giorno nuovo, while the song Meno male che ci sei tu features the special participation of Motta (Sick Tamburo’s first fan) on vocals and darabouka. A version of the song “La fine della chemio,” from the album “Un giorno nuovo,” is being released, featuring some of the best Italian singers: Jovanotti, Tre Allegri Ragazzi Morti, Manuel Agnelli, Samuel, Elisa, Meg, Lo Stato Sociale, Pierpaolo Capovilla, and Prozac+. The artists perform the song alongside Elisabetta Imelio and Gian Maria Accusani, former members of Prozac+ and part of Sick Tamburo, for a charity project. Proceeds will be donated in part to A.N.D.O.S. of Pordenone, an association for women who have undergone breast surgery, a group of highly active volunteers, and in part to the “Donne in Rosa Lago Burida” canoe team, women who have undergone breast surgery and who use sport to spread their motto: “Together we always win.” Paura e l’amore, the new album of original songs published by La Tempesta dischi, will be released on April 5, 2019, followed by an extensive promotional tour. In 2020, the band announced their Back to the Roots project, culminating in the album Back to the Roots (Forse è l’amore), released in 2022. This album reinterprets Sick Tamburo’s most significant songs in a melodic punk style. The album was followed by an extensive tour that lasted throughout 2022. On April 21, 2023, Sick Tamburo released their new album of original songs, Non credere a nessuno, their sixth album, via La Tempesta Dischi. It was preceded by the single “Per sempre con me,” featuring Roberta Sammarelli (Verdena). The band then embarked on an extensive tour throughout Italy. On November 19, 2025, the single and video “Ho perso i sogni” were released, followed on December 18 by the song “Silvia corre sola”: the first two previews of the new album, due out in early 2026. This coming September sees the start of ‘The Wheels In Motion Tour’, a three-band bill that will support indie venues up and down the country, showcasing some of the UKs most thrilling indie rock talent with The Jacques, The Sukis and Pistol Daisys. Curated by indie live agency Motion Talent, all three bands are part of the emerging artists on their roster, and the tour aims to boost grassroots touring through indie venues with a fan friendly low-ticket price. First up, London via Bristol trio The Jacques have been carving their way up and down the country and the EU with post punk legends Public Image Limited in recent times, and since first forming as young teenagers, they’ve supported The Libertines at Hyde Park and played Glastonbury, Reading and Leeds. Their story has been fraught with as many ups as downs, but The Jacques have proved themselves to be true road warriors and survivors. Their genre-smashing fusion of mutant punk, psychedelic grunge and joyous indie rock never fails to hit the spot. Also joining the tour are Liverpool’s The Sukis, who are fast making a name for themselves as one of the most exciting alternative rock bands on the scene today. Punky, intelligent and an explosive live act, their songs dive deep into the psyche of what it is to be young. Lastly, Pistol Daisys are storming the alt-pop scene with a fierce energy that’s quickly earned them a devoted following, blending Glasgow’s vibrant grit with heartfelt authenticity to create music that captivates fans across Scotland all the way to Europe. Their live shows convey a whirlwind of raw emotion and authentic connection, thrilling audiences and filling venues with a sound that blends confessional songwriting with dance-oriented hooks, drawing comparisons to bands like Blondie and mixing pop, rock and electronic elements. gig.title: Little Barrie
gig.pageText: Little Barrie – Dingwalls Skip to content Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Little Barrie Friday, 25 September 2026 , 19:00 £26.50 BUY NOW Support from Edgar Jones Cast in the grand tradition of great British rock bands, and fuelled by a love of American blues, funk and soul, Little Barrie’s sixth studio album is the first released solely under the band’s own name since the death of drummer Virgil Howe in September 2017. The LP follows more than two decades of activity that have established the band as a key force in UK psychedelic rock and soul. Following Howe’s passing, Cadogan and founding bassist Lewis Wharton placed the future of the band on hold. After initial plans to resume playing were disrupted by the Covid-19 pandemic, the pair began collaborating with long-time friend Malcolm Catto (The Heliocentrics). This partnership resulted in two albums, Quatermass Seven (2020) and Electric War, released on Easy Eye Sound in April 2025. For Gravity Freeze, the hooks are sharper, the grooves are deeper, and the atmospherics thicker, building on the band’s previous, highly-acclaimed work. “Have you ever had sleep paralysis?” asks Cadogan, discussing the title track of the trio’s latest offering. “That’s what ‘Gravity Freeze’ is written about. It’s like a nickname I gave to that moment where you’ve woken up and you’re still dreaming. The first time that happened to me, I freaked because I couldn’t move, but I couldn’t tell if I was awake or not. It’s a very strange feeling, and you do weird things, like trying to walk through wardrobes. There are a few elements on the album that reflect what we’ve been through in the last few years. We’ve been through a lot, some of which we’re still processing.” Work on the LP began in late 2023. The album was recorded at Rat Salad Studios in Hornsey, North London, with Rupert Lyddon serving as recording engineer and co-producer. Continuing the band’s established DIY approach, early demos were captured in a cold room room in Dalston surrounded by partial drum kits, art equipment, and random bits of wood and metal, before formal recording sessions began. Coote joined the band for the album, contributing performances informed by classic jazz, soul and blues rhythms. Recording took place alongside Cadogan’s commitments as a touring and session guitarist, including work with Liam Gallagher and John Squire, The Black Keys, and THE THE, as well as sessions at Easy Eye Sound Studios in Nashville. Gravity Freeze was written and sequenced with vinyl in mind and marks over 25 years since Little Barrie’s first singles on Stark Reality. The release represents a new chapter for the band following a nine-year gap since their previous studio album. It’s 45 years since ACR went into Revolution Studios in Cheadle Hulme, Stockport to record the 1982 album Sextet and it’s 40 years since the release of the 1986 album Force which was also recorded in Stockport but at Yellow 2. Sextet is ACR’s most critically acclaimed album and it was the first album they produced as ACR, it includes the majestic Lucinda and the live favourite Knife Slits Water. Force is one of their most commercial albums, produced by ACR and the late Stuart (Jammer) James and is their last album on Factory Records, it includes funky masterpiece Mickey Way and live party favourite Si Firmo O Grido. Each album is starkly different to each other yet very clearly ACR. “We’re celebrating these two milestones with this tour to say we are very excited is an understatement. It will be a real challenge, which we’ve already started preparing for, with nine months to go! We will be playing two sets with no support” Sextet 11 weeks on the UK independent chart and reached No 1 Force spent 9 weeks on the UK independent charts peaking at No. 2. Sounds 5 star review “SEXTET is an album of the present, killing the past and agreeably ignoring the future. It is an after-Rock Record. This is one of the most strategically tired albums you’ll hear all year. Dal 2001 porta in tour i suoi spettacoli di stand-up comedy nei maggiori teatri italiani. With over 1.2 million albums sold and 17 ARIA Award nominations, he has consistently sat at the summit of the industry, boasting three consecutive #1 albums. His breakthrough 2003 record, Feeler, became the definitive soundtrack for a generation, remaining in the charts for over eighty weeks and spawning hits like “So Beautiful” and “Opportunity.” Since then, his unique blend of acoustic rock and soulful folk has remained a permanent fixture in the Australian cultural landscape. In 2026, Murray is navigating a powerful creative renaissance following the release of his eighth studio album, Longing. Released in late 2025, the record marks a monumental milestone as his first completely independent release in over two decades – a move that has seen him reclaim his masters and his creative narrative. A decade in the making, the album debuted at #5 on the ARIA charts, blending his signature acoustic warmth with gritty, synth-driven textures and hypnotic rhythms. It is an album that reflects a “life lived,” trading on the same soul-stirring honesty that first made him a household name while showcasing a sophisticated, modern evolution. Having recently completed a massive 59-date tour across the country, Murray’s live performances remain a masterclass in both intimacy and anthemic energy. Whether stripping it back to a solo acoustic set or leading a full band through his expansive catalog, he remains a world-class storyteller with an unmatched ability to connect with an audience. In 2026, he isn’t just a veteran of the scene; he is an artist at the peak of his powers, proving that for a songwriter of his caliber, the best work is still being written. gig.pageText: Marlene Kuntz – Dingwalls Skip to content Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Marlene Kuntz Monday, 19th October 2026 , 19:30 £30 + Fees BUY NOW Quando vide la luce, il 26 aprile 1996, Il Vile fu come uno squarcio improvviso nel cielo musicale italiano: chitarre che graffiavano l’aria con distorsioni taglienti, linee melodiche che si muovevano tra ombra e luce, parole che cadevano come pietre e al tempo stesso si sollevavano come visioni poetiche. Inserito da Rolling Stone Italia nella classifica dei 100 dischi italiani più belli di sempre, con questo album i Marlene Kuntz seppero trasformare inquietudine e fragilità in una lingua nuova, dove il dolore diventava bellezza, la rabbia lirica, l’angoscia canto corale. Una scrittura che aprì uno squarcio nell’immaginario collettivo, trasformando l’intimo tormento in esperienza condivisa. Ogni brano di Il Vile è un mondo a sé: c’è l’impatto elettrico che scuote il corpo, la dolcezza che arriva all’improvviso a spiazzare, l’alternanza di furia e silenzi sospesi, come se la musica seguisse i battiti di un’anima inquieta. Non è un disco da ascoltare soltanto: è un’esperienza che si attraversa, tra graffi e carezze, tra vertigini e abbandoni. A trent’anni di distanza, quell’urgenza non si è affievolita: anzi, risuona con ancora maggiore lucidità, dimostrando che Il Vile non appartiene a un’epoca conclusa, ma continua a dialogare con il presente. Le sue parole parlano alle disillusioni contemporanee, le sue chitarre gridano ancora contro il vuoto, le sue atmosfere offrono uno specchio alle inquietudini di oggi. Dopo il successo del tour per festeggiare i 30 anni del loro disco d’esordio, diventato una vera e propria festa di compleanno collettiva, i Marlene Kuntz danno appuntamento al loro pubblico nel 2026 con il tour “Marlene Kuntz suona Il Vile”, in cui la band riporterà dal vivo, città dopo città, tutta la potenza di un album che ha segnato un’intera generazione. Expect pathos. Expect humour. Expect volume. Never one to coast on being a nepo baby — even if her parentage is hardly a secret — Carthy has spent decades championing English music, traditional and progressive, earning a reputation as a fearless mixer of genres and an even more fearless speaker of her mind. Eliza has played everywhere, from the Royal Albert Hall to The Getty Centre, by way of folk clubs, Ghana, and drum & bass basements in Brixton. For Carthy it’s all one music — Rock, World, Folk, all threaded together, indivisible. Frenemies is her best go yet at proving it. And so to the launch, and a special one-off show at Camden’s legendary Dingwalls, where Eliza Carthy and the Restitution will be blasting through the album in all its glory, and who knows – they may even be joined by one of the incredible collaborators: Jools Holland, Robyn Hitchcock, KT Tunstall, Jos Vantyler, Queen of Harps, Miranda Richardson and Tim McInnerny. This will be a show not to be missed. Saturday, 24th October 2026 , 19:00 £20 BUY NOW The story of Ben Quad is punctuated by moments of randomness: a chance meeting via Craigslist, bonding over bands like Microwave and Modern Baseball. An out-of-nowhere name drop from indie tastemaker Ian Cohen lauding their debut album, 2022’s I’m Scared That’s All There Is. A one-off sonic curveball that somehow turned into their biggest song – and, without them realising it at the time, a brand-new freedom to reinvent themselves. It’s taught them to thrive inside the unpredictable, to harness a no-limits musical mentality and self-effacing sense of humour and turn it into some of the most resonant, captivating emo of today. Well, actually, post-emo. That shift in perspective carries directly into the subject matter of their 2025 record, Wisher. In stark contrast to the heavy existential questions the band posed on I’m Scared That’s All There Is, the songs here aren’t about survival but rather savouring life’s small victories – the moments that might not feel like much at the time but can snowball into something bigger if you only allow yourself to find the joy in them. In many ways, it’s much like Ben Quad themselves, their own story built on a string of seemingly minor twists of fate that’s only been amplified by a relentless DIY attitude and instinct to chase every idea, no matter how improbable. Where will this story take them next? Well, to their very first London headline show, for one thing. The twist? Under the leadership of YoshimiO, a founding member of Boredoms, the group has recorded music that have subverted expectations and warped perceptions of what constitutes pop and experimental music. OOIOO began as a fictitious band for a photo shoot for Switch magazine in 1996. The all-female four-piece ensemble includes Yoshimi, guitarist Kayan, bassist Aya and Ritsuko Mishina on drums. The band quickly gained attention by being the opening act for Sonic Youth in 1997. While the band’s tours of the United States are infrequent, they are as the New York Times has stated, transcendent – taking their love of indigenous music into an entirely new dimension by freely weaving organic and electric tones into a vivid tapestry, employing their keen sense of color and texture. OOIOO’s music is constantly evolving from release to release, from one band to another. Intense performers and creators, drawing from a wide range of influences, the band has invented a heartfelt musical language that is eclectic yet accessible and completely their own – dense and frantic. OOIOO has always been the best outlet from YoshimiO to articulate her unique talents and swirling, dreamy tunes. gig.pageText: CLUB.THE.MAMMOTH. presents: CUD + special guests – Dingwalls Skip to content Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 CLUB.THE.MAMMOTH. presents: CUD + special guests Friday, 6th November 2026 , 19:30 £27.50 BUY NOW Emerging from the same art/design cauldron that produced fellow Leeds legends Soft Cell, Scritti Politti, and The Mekons, CUD were the pre-Britpop answer to doleful shoegazing bands – fun-loving, light-hearted, romantic and downright catchy. Alternatively loved or loathed like a yeast extract, CUD are indie rock for the unpretentious pleasure seeker, boasting as they do the rich deep-lunged voice of Carl Puttnam, edgy guitars of Mike Dunphy and tight, funky rhythm section of William Potter, bass and Gogs Byrn, drums. CUD were initially lauded for their quirky Peel session cover of ‘You Sexy Thing’ in 1987. They soon built up a huge live following and buffed up their repertoire with a string of unstraight pop beauties, best exemplified by the 1990 album ‘Leggy Mambo’. This led to a major-label deal with A&M in 1991, front-page NME coverage, massive sellout gigs and proper Top 30 hits, ‘Rich and Strange’ and ‘Purple Love Balloon’. Misunderstood by record companies and press, CUD packed away their guitars and sticks in 1995 but, bolstered by a greatest hits anthology (‘Rich and Strange’) in 2006, they agreed to tread the boards again, with a further reunion following in 2012 (now with original guitarist and key songwriter Mike Dunphy) and continue to find an army of ‘Space CUDets’ still eager to sing along, dance like fruitcakes and invade their stage. gig.pageText: Rock For Hope – Dingwalls Skip to content Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Home What’s On Info Gallery Hire Dingwalls 2 Lock 17 Rock For Hope Saturday, 7th November 2026 , 18:30 £10 BUY NOW Rock for Hope isn’t just a gig, it’s our way of raising vital funds for the Gift of Hope Trust, our charity that works to ensure every child has access to education, no matter where they’re growing up. Gift of Hope partners with grassroots organisations in India, Ghana, Malawi and Uganda to build and support sustainable education projects, from classrooms and toilet blocks to safe teacher accommodation and vocational training colleges. Every band that takes to the stage gives their time for free, ensuring the majority of ticket sales goes directly towards creating long-term impact on the ground. This is why we Rock for Hope. And we’d love you to be part of it. Landline: The Landline were formed in North London in 2021 of a collective desire to play the finest tunes from one of rock and pop music’s greatest decades: the Nineties. Naturally, this encompasses many of the big Britpop bands of the time – from Oasis, Blur and Pulp to The Bluetones, Travis and Supergrass – but also the best of the Madchester scene (including the Stone Roses and Happy Mondays), some great dance cuts (Fatboy Slim, Chemical Brothers), several much-loved alternative acts (Eels, Belle & Sebastian, Primal Scream) and even the occasional foray into classic indie from other eras (Joy Division, Arctic Monkeys). Firefly: Firefly burst out of the Camden youth scene in late 2025 and have been lighting up the North London circuit ever since. As prominent members of the INTRA collective they have headlined sold out shows at Camden’s iconic Jazz Cafe, The Camden Club and more with their mix of Motown soul, vintage grooves and modern pop funk anthems. The band are Miya (vocals), Max (guitar), Humphrey (keys), April (bass) and Alfred (drums). Gift of Noise: Gift of Noise is an energetic and versatile eight-piece band hailing from London. Known for their powerful live performances and eclectic mix of genres, they bring a unique blend of talent to every stage. With dynamic vocals, rich instrumentation, and a diverse repertoire spanning rock, pop, soul, and more, Gift of Noise captivates audiences at events across the city and beyond. Their ability to seamlessly fuse different styles ensures an unforgettable musical experience, making them one of London’s most exciting live acts. Their setlist spans a diverse mix of genres, blending iconic hits from Motown, rock, indie, grime, and hip-hop. The inclusion of The Jackson 5, Muse, The Killers, Stormzy, Eminem, a-ha, Journey. Together, this genre mix creates a dynamic and versatile experience, appealing to a wide audience. gig.pageText: CHANEL YATES | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go CHANEL YATES The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Wed 16th September 2026 7:00 pm £16 Date: Wed 16th September 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £16 Tickets are now available for CHANEL YATES at The Garage! Chanel Yates is the pocket-sized cowgirl everyone’s talking about. With a fast growing global fanbase Chanel’s honest, no filter songwriting has made her one of the most exciting new voices to watch in country music. Rooted in real life moments, heartbreak and humour, Chanel’s power anthems have resonated with fans around the world, gaining millions of streams and landing on top editorial playlists across Spotify and Apple Music. Chanel is creating a huge buzz in the UK and overseas with her relatable lyrics paired with a viral line dance for one of her latest records “Big Girl Boots.” On stage, she brings her signature style and infectious energy to life, lighting up festivals like C2C, Tramlines, Reading and Leeds Festival, and most recently hitting the road across the UK and Europe on tour with Alexandra Kay and currently set to play BST Hyde park alongside Garth Brooks this summer. Whether she is playing sold out headline shows or writing in Nashville, Chanel continues to break genre boundaries. She’s the sister you call after a breakup and your new bestie in country music! gig.pageText: SOUTH SUMMIT | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go SOUTH SUMMIT The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Thu 8th October 2026 7:00 pm £16 Date: Thu 8th October 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm Supported By: BEN KIDSON + KAYLA GRACE On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £16 Tickets are now available for SOUTH SUMMIT at The Garage! South Summit, one of the best young live bands out of Australia right now, return to the UK and Europe this September–October 2026 in support of their new album RUN IT BACK, following a recent run of shows supporting Australian favourites The Terrys. Widely regarded for their explosive, feel-good performances, South Summit have built a reputation as a must-see act, bringing a level of energy that consistently lights up every room they play. RUN IT BACK, their second studio album, marks a bold evolution in the band’s sound. Featuring standout singles “TOP OF THE HILL” and “ON THE DASH,” the twelve-track release captures a period of creative expansion, with the band exploring elements of funk, hip hop and R&B while staying true to their signature fusion of reggae and rock. The tour will see South Summit take in cities across the UK and Europe, including Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, Münster, Groningen, Nijmegen, Cologne, Antwerp, Paris, Bristol, Leeds, Manchester, Glasgow, Nottingham, London and Amsterdam, alongside an appearance at Reeperbahn Festival. Renowned for their infectious energy and crowd connection, fans can expect a dynamic live show packed with new material from RUN IT BACK, alongside the fan favourites that have fuelled their rapid rise. gig.pageText: DAMIAN LEWIS | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go DAMIAN LEWIS The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Wed 14th October 2026 7:00 pm £35 Date: Wed 14th October 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £35 Tickets are now available for DAMIAN LEWIS at The Garage! Damian Lewis released his acclaimed debut album Mission Creep in 2023, earning praise for its soulful vocals, rich instrumentation, and emotional honesty. Hailed by critics as “beautifully written and performed” (Line Of Best Fit) and “a warm, rich debut,” (Financial Times) the record marked him as a genuine new voice in British music and established Lewis as a songwriter with something urgent and real to say. Sweet Chaos is the album that follows from a place of hard-won clarity. Written two years on, it is bolder, broader, and at times more raw. “The first album was quiet and tender,” Lewis says. “This new album is a bit angrier in places. You don’t know these things until you listen back: the extent to which your state of mind pervades the thing.” A BAFTA, Emmy and Golden Globe-winning actor, Lewis first honed his musical instincts busking across Europe in his youth – an experience that informs the raw authenticity of his work. He quickly proved his strength as a live performer, winning acclaim for his charismatic stage presence and selling out venues across the UK, alongside festival appearances including Latitude, Wilderness, Black Deer and the EFG London Jazz Festival. Sweet Chaos will be released 5 June 2026 For more events, check out what’s on here. gig.pageText: CHRI$TIAN GATE$ | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go CHRI$TIAN GATE$ The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Thu 15th October 2026 7:00 pm £22.50 Date: Thu 15th October 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm Supported By: JULIA ALEXA On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £22.50 Tickets are now available for CHRI$TIAN GATE$ at The Garage! Meet Chri$tian Gate$ – a beacon for the resilient, a testament to music’s transformative power, and an audacious talent from Orange County. His journey from poetry to rap, pop, R&B, rock, and now folk reflects a relentless evolution. Drawing from a diverse range of influences, Gate$ defies genre norms. His turbulent youth, marked by street racing and run-ins with the law, resonates in his music, making him a voice for the triumphant. Behind the scenes, Gate$ remains hands-on. He was once his own audio engineer, and now closely collaborates with others. His electric performances, like his sold-out show at LA’s Roxy, Mercury Lounge, Sub T, and Lollapolooza radiate an undeniable energy. Gate$ invites listeners to find their own meaning in his songs, making his music a personal canvas. His rebellious spirit endures, symbolized by his black 2008 Corvette—a tribute to his past. Poised to explore the folk genre with an upcoming EP, Gate$ continues to be a voice for the voiceless, turning adversity into art. For more events, check out what’s on here. gig.pageText: THE QUIREBOYS | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go THE QUIREBOYS The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Sun 18th October 2026 7:00 pm £32.50 Date: Sun 18th October 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm Supported By: The Karma Effect + Soho Dukes On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £32.50 Tickets are now available for THE QUIREBOYS at The Garage! Spike is the founder and front man of the Quireboys – one of the UK’s most enduring rock ‘n’ roll bands. A band that’s been through different chapters and had different line-ups, but Spike is the constant throughout. Song writer, singer and leader of a band with which he has now become synonymous. With lifelong friend Guy Bailey, Spike penned the benchmark Quireboys songs – such as Hey You, I Don’t Love You Any More and 7 O’Clock – tracks which have defined the band musically for decades and, to this day, remain the hallmark songs of any Quireboys show. With sad passing of Guy Bailey fresh in his mind, and the addition of Long term allies, Luke Morley and Harry James, both from UK legends, THUNDER, and the return of Nigel Mogg on bass, the Quireboys released the acclaimed album, Wardour Street, and have reclaimed their rightful position as stalwarts of the UK Rock scene For more events, check out what’s on here. gig.pageText: GHØSTKID | The Garage | London Navigation Toggle Home What’s On Tickets News Venue History Location Hire The Grace Info FAQs Accessibility Customer & Privacy Policies Contact Facebook Instagram Twitter Spotify Go GHØSTKID The Garage, London BUY TICKETS Sun 25th October 2026 7:00 pm £24 Date: Sun 25th October 2026 Doors Open: 7:00 pm On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £24 Tickets are now available for GHØSTKID at The Garage! GHØSTKID emerged in 2024 as an entity untamed, unfiltered, and resonating with raw, unapologetic rebellion. They’ve captivated audiences worldwide and set new standards in the fusion of metal, industrial, goth, and pop. 2024 has been a landmark year for the band. Their album HOLLYWOOD SUICIDE, released on March 22nd, 2024, delivered a sonic onslaught of ferocious intensity and emotional depth. Each track tells a tale of anguish, passion, and unrelenting determination, exploring the raw truths of life and the human psyche. Sculpted under the guidance of renowned producer Sky van Hoff, the album stands as a testament to GHØSTKID’s artistic fervor and singer Sushi’s personality. In 2024 GHØSTKID played 110+ shows, including their first US tour, supporting Black Veil Brides, a EU tour supporting Blind Channel and their first European headliner tour, Also they capped the year with a big hometown xmas show. Joined by musical conspirators Jappo Van Glory (guitar), Chris Canterbury (guitar), Stanislaw Czywil (bass), and Steve Joakim (drums), GHØSTKID creates more than just music—they craft a transformative, soul-stirring experience. The band boldly ventures into new realms of expression, weaving a tapestry of darkness and aggression. Prepare to be consumed by the chaos. GHØSTKID is rebellion in its purest form—a visceral, unrelenting journey into the darker realms of music and emotion. Embrace the chaos. For more events, check out what’s on here. Think again! Centre 59 Theatre Week is your chance to go behind the scenes and explore how to create stories for the stage. Build Your Own Week This week is all about trying something new and unlocking your potential. Designed for people who have little to no experience in theatre, each day you’ll get to choose from a menu of practical workshops in areas such as: Action & Stunts (Stagecraft & Combat): Learn about physical timing, choreography, and fight-work used in action scenes. Creating Characters (Improvisation): Learn to think on your feet and build characters from scratch. Writing the Script (Script & Development): Bring your own real-life stories and ideas to the page. Movement (Physical Theatre & Dance): Get active and learn how to use music and movement to command a room. Backstage (Set design / directing): Get interactive tips and behind-the-scenes insights from working industry professionals that make theatre a magical experience. What you’ll get: A hands-on taste of acting, writing, devising and directing. A welcoming space to meet new people and collaborate. Direct coaching from expert mentors who know how to build your skills. A confidence boost that will help you speak up and hold any room. Who it’s for: You don’t need to be a ‘theatre kid’ to fit in here. Whether you’ve only ever done a bit of drama at school or are trying this for the very first time, everyone starts from scratch. There are no auditions to worry about, just come willing to get stuck in! Please note: To keep things fair for absolute beginners, this project is not open to anyone currently or recently undertaking intensive vocational performing arts training. (This could include CAT programs, associations with professional training schools, or performing at a high grade level.) About Centre 59 Centre 59 is an accessible space and entry point for young people to the artform of storytelling in theatre and the performing arts. Core to Centre 59 is the mission to build young artists who learn to share their own stories through a programme of writing, acting, directing and producing. Centre 59 is a creative partnership from Roundhouse and 59% Productions, spearheaded by Roundhouse Associate Artistic Director Daniel Kaluuya. With Director Evelyn Duah and Associate Director Louie Keen. Information for Parents: This project is an affordable, fully supervised summer holiday programme. It is designed to keep young people socially connected and engaged. Our team of professional facilitators create a safe environment where teamwork and real-world confidence are prioritised over theatrical perfection. Essential info: Ages: 15–17 (This project also runs for 11-14s and 18-25s) Times: 9.30am–4pm (A full day of active, structured engagement) Location: Backstage Studio at Roundhouse, Camden. Price: £20 for the entire week (financial support available) How to book Places are open to everyone and booked on a first-come, first-served basis. Secure your spot using the button below To book you must: Be aged 15–17, fit our beginner eligibility requirements, and be available for the full Monday to Friday week. WHO IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR A PLACE? This project is not open to anyone who has currently, or recently, taken part in any vocational or intensive performing arts training. (This could include CAT programs, associations with professional training schools, or performing at a high grade level.) This is to help us ensure the project is accessible to those who have not experienced similar projects or training before. Previous year’s participants cannot repeat the same age group, but can book if they have moved into a new age bracket. I’M NOT SURE I CAN AFFORD TO TAKE PART… If you need help to pay for things like project fees, transport or childcare, we can help. Find out how you can get support. If you are using a bursary to pay for the project, please ensure you arrange this with the Advice Base with plenty of time before the start of the project. I HAVE ADDITIONAL NEEDS. WHAT SUPPORT IS AVAILABLE? We are committed to supporting D/deaf, disabled and neurodiverse young people, those with medical conditions, access requirements or any lived experience that may require adaptation, support or sensitivity. If there is anything you would like to let us (our youth workers, tutors or staff) know that will support your enjoyment and access, you can do so by emailing us at advicebase@roundhouse.org.uk, and we will contact you to discuss further how to best support your engagement. Services & Suppliers Standing Receptions Weddings & Celebrations Home What's On Selector Lab: DJ Curation & Radio Programming Selector Lab: DJ Curation & Radio Programming Ages 18-25 Dates & tickets Ready to turn your selection into a professional broadcast? Step into our professional studios to find your unique voice as a presenter and music curator. This is an intensive five-part project designed to give emerging DJs the technical skills, creative confidence, and industry connections to launch their own radio shows. What you’ll gain: Curation & Programming: Learn the art of music research, track selection, and thematic storytelling for air. Show Identity: Build a unique radio brand and find your authentic voice behind the mic. Technical DJ Mastery: Gain hands-on experience using professional DJ equipment to select and mix tracks for broadcast. Recording & Production: Practice recording radio segments, live mixes, and spoken content in a studio setting. Meet the Tutor Gaby D’Annunzio is a creative director, curator, and broadcaster working at the intersection of music, culture, and social impact. As co-founder of Open Music Lab and a founding member of Refuge Worldwide in Berlin, she has built community-focused music spaces from the ground up, conceptualising, securing funding, and launching platforms that amplify underrepresented voices. Since returning to London, she has developed music strategy and programming for Sister Midnight, Counterpoints Arts, Oxfam and Compass Collective. As a broadcaster and lifelong record collector, she brings a perspective shaped by years exploring music scenes and the cultural narratives behind them. Her work is often inspired by themes of migration and the ways these stories are expressed through sound. Plus guests! We will also have guest tutors for some sessions who will bring their expertise. Who it’s for: Emerging creatives and DJs aged 18-25. You should be an active listener with a deep interest in music discovery. Experience with DJing or building playlists is helpful but not essential. How to join: This is an application-based programme. To apply, complete our online application form by Friday 3 July, 10am. Successful applicants will be notified by Friday 10 July. Dates: Mon 10- Fri 14 August Times: 11am-5pm Ages: 18-25 Location: Roundhouse Studios Price: £20 I’M NOT SURE I CAN AFFORD TO TAKE PART… If you need help to pay for things like project fees, transport or childcare, we can help. Find out how you can get support. If you are using a bursary to pay for the project, please ensure you arrange this with the Advice Base with plenty of time before the start of the project. I HAVE ADDITIONAL NEEDS. WHAT SUPPORT IS AVAILABLE? We are committed to supporting D/deaf, disabled and neurodiverse young people, those with medical conditions, access requirements or any lived experience that may require adaptation, support or sensitivity. If there is anything you would like to let us (our youth workers, tutors or staff) know that will support your enjoyment and access, you can do so by emailing us at advicebase@roundhouse.org.uk, and we will contact you to discuss further how to best support your engagement. Stop the daily grind and spend a day building the professional roadmap you need to succeed. Freelancer Strategy Day is an intensive one-day project led by creative producer Louise Clarke to help you clarify your vision and master your income streams. What you’ll gain: Vision & Purpose: Reconnect with what makes your work unique and clarify your long-term creative goals. Income Strategy: Discover sustainable ways to generate income without exhausting your creative energy. Strategic Roadmap: Create a clear, actionable plan for the coming year that aligns with your core values. Peer Accountability: Connect with a network of like-minded freelancers for future collaboration and support. Immediate Action: Leave with practical steps to move your business forward and a network to keep you on track. Meet the Tutor Louise Clarke is a London-based creative producer and founder of Four Letters London, a consultancy and production company championing meaningful ideas and talented teams. With over a decade of experience across short films, branded content, music videos, commercials, and editorials, Louise focuses on storytelling that blends creativity, heart, and impact, working with artists, global brands, and grassroots organisations to bring culturally resonant stories to life. www.fourletterslondon.com IG: @fourletters_ldn / @magiclou_works Who it’s for: Creative entrepreneurs and freelancers aged 18–30. Whether you are looking to scale your business or just starting to build your brand, no prior experience is needed. How to join: Spaces are limited. Secure your spot now to avoid disappointment. Gamble Hosted by Kiri Pritchard-McLean, plus Nick Mohammed, Jamali Maddix & Sam Nicoresti Dates & tickets Comedy Show Tickets London 2026 Headlining this powerhouse line-up is Ed Gamble, co-host of the award-winning mega-hit podcast Off Menu with James Acaster, Taskmaster champion and host of The Traitors: Uncloaked and Taskmaster the Podcast. A fixture on UK TV, Ed has been seen and heard on Live At the Apollo, Mock the Week, QI, Would I Lie To You, and his new panel show, Unacceptable. Joining Ed are Nick Mohammed, Jamali Maddix, Sam Nicoresti, and Kiri Pritchard-McLean. Nick Mohammed is a double Emmy-nominated actor, writer, and comedian. As his critically acclaimed alter-ego Mr. Swallow, Nick has just finished his major UK tour Show Pony, which received multiple five star reviews and was extended twice due to demand. Nick reached the final of last year’s Celebrity Traitors and was one of the worst contestants in the history of Taskmaster. Mr. Swallow has been seen on Last One Laughing, numerous episodes of Channel 4’s 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, and the 2024 BAFTA Film Awards. Nick plays Nate in Apple TV’s hit multi award-winning series Ted Lasso, for which he was nominated twice for Outstanding Supporting Actor at the Emmy Awards. Nick created, wrote, and starred (alongside David Schwimmer) in his own Sky TV hit show Intelligence. Dynamite stand-up Jamali Maddix is a regular on Never Mind the Buzzcocks, host of Vice’s acclaimed series Hate Thy Neighbour and Dave’s Follow the Leader, and co-host of the new Comedy Central Series Am I the Asshole?. Jamali has also appeared on hit shows including Taskmaster Series 11, Live At the Apollo, Qi and 8 Out of 10 Cats. Sam Nicoresti won the Edinburgh Comedy Award for Best Show in 2025 with her hit show Baby Doomer, which has since toured around the world. Her obsessive neuroticism and lyrical phrasing blends with a surrealist instinct and childish playfulness to create thick, delirious routines. Our host for the night is Kiri Pritchard-McLean, a powerhouse stand-up who tackles thorny subjects with humor, grace, and deep personal insight. A fixture on UK entertainment television, Kiri has hosted Live at the Apollo and appeared on Have I Got News For You, 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, and QI. Due to a change in scheduling, sadly Amy Gledhill will no longer be performing at this event. present Jack Rooke: Good Grief a decade retrospective of capitalising on my dead dad to varied levels of failure and success Dates & tickets Comedy Show Tickets London 2026 BAFTA-winning writer and recovering spoken-word artist Jack Rooke (Creator of Hulu / C4’s Big Boys) brings back his debut comedy-theatre show ‘Good Grief’, a decade on from it launching his career. The show returns to London on tour at the Roundhouse Comedy Festival, having originally been developed at the Roundhouse in 2014. Featuring the original show (co-written with his 80-year old Nan Sicely) and some present day musings, this retrospective further explores grief, ambition, being a class traitor, milking having a dead dad for personal/professional gain, the innocence of writing just for oneself before the interference of “telly wankers”, and the palpable regret of his own decline into becoming said “telly wanker”. Content Warning: this show may contain potentially triggering stories around grief, suicide and Geri leaving the Spice Girls in May 1998. Directed by Gabriel Bisset-Smith (now also a telly wanker). ‘Good Grief 2.0 [is] a delightful and still affecting watch’ Guardian ‘Engaging, frank and humorous.’ New York Times 'A delight... cheerily but sensitively tackling the most painful of subjects and finding hope in them' ★★★★ — Scotsman Berk’s Nest in association with Soho Theatre, Curtis Brown, and Roundhouse Comedy Festival present Jack Rooke: Good Grief a decade retrospective of capitalising on my dead dad to varied levels of failure and success Roundhouse Main Space Dates & Times Fri 14 Aug 26 7:30pm £5 - £38 Book See more dates See fewer dates Booking Dates Friday 24 April 10am General Public Booking Thursday 23 April 10am Advance Priority Booking for Champion, Icon and Legend members Thursday 23 April 2pm Priority Booking for all members Stage Times Starts: 7:30pm Running time: 1 hour and 50 minutes including an interval Essential Info & Fees Fees are 7.5% + a £3 restoration levy* per ticket This event may contain potentially triggering stories around grief, suicide and Geri leaving the Spice Girls in May 1998. With Nina Conti, John Kearns, Harriet Kemsley and Michael Odewale. Dates & tickets Comedy Show Tickets London 2026 Sara Pascoe presents a very special evening of comedy as she hosts a spectacular line-up of her funniest friends. Following the massive success of her latest stand-up show, I Am a Strange Gloop, which toured extensively across the UK, Australia, and Canada, Sara is bringing her unique wit to the Roundhouse stage for this unmissable event. Sara’s TV appearances have included Taskmaster (Channel 4), Live at the Apollo (BBC Two), QI (BBC Two), 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown (Channel 4), and Mock the Week (BBC Two). Sara’s friends will include Nina Conti, John Kearns, Harriet Kemsley and Michael Odewale. Nina Conti is an award-winning comedian, BAFTA-nominated filmmaker, and acclaimed ventriloquist. Following the rave reviews for her narrative film debut Sunlight, the Live at the Apollo, Qi, and House of Games star continues to bring her unique, world-class talent to the stage. John Kearns is an actor, writer and the only comedian to have won both the Edinburgh Comedy Awards for Best Show and Best Newcomer in the awards’ 40-year history. He was a breakout star of series 14 of Taskmaster and alongside Sara was the co-host of Guessable. He has also appeared on Live at the Apollo, 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, and House of Games. Harriet Kemsley is an award winning comedian, writer and actress. She was seen on the first season of Last One Laughing UK, as well as appearing on Would I Lie To You, 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, House of Games, and Live at the Apollo. Michael Odewale is an acclaimed stand-up who has been seen on Live at the Apollo and Friday Night Live. He has been nominated for British Comedy Guide’s New Big Thing award, won Best Headliner at the Chortle Awards, and was nominated for an Emmy Award in the category of Outstanding Writing for a Variety Special for his work on Cunk On Life. Vittorio Angelone & Friends with Kyla Cobbler, Troy Hawke, Janine Harouni, and Micky Overman Dates & tickets Comedy Show Tickets London 2026 A night of stand-up comedy hosted and curated by Vittorio Angelone, featuring some of his favourite comedians in the whole world. Having grown up in Belfast, and moved to London to train as a classical musician, he made the predictable switch to stand-up comedy. Vittorio’s most recent tour You Can’t Say Nothing Any More has sold-out around the world, including dates at London’s Eventim Apollo and the 2026 Netflix is a Joke Festival in Los Angeles. Since 2018, Angelone has built an audience of over half a million followers across all platforms with stand-up clips, podcasts and sketches amassing millions of views online. He co-hosts the hit podcast MIKE & VITTORIO’S GUIDE TO PARENTING and co-created the viral YouTube show FIN VS THE INTERNET. He’s a 2025 JFL New Face, has recently starred in a comedy pilot ‘Rewarding’ for the BBC, and was featured on Deadline’s 2026 list of stand-ups who are ‘The Future of Funny’. At the Roundhouse, Vittorio’s friends will include Kyla Cobbler, Troy Hawke, Janine Harouni, and Micky Overman. Kyla Cobbler is one of the fastest-rising names in comedy. The Cork-born comic first gained attention through her viral Instagram reels, with over 1M Instagram followers and 100M+ views. Following a trail of sold-out performances across Ireland and the UK, Kyla made her debut at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival 2025 with her smash-hit show, Gone Rogue, and has since announced her debut North American tour. Viral sensation and star of Live at the Apollo, Troy Hawke is an award-winning comedian currently embarking on a global tour in 2026 with his brand-new show, Never Stop, Never Change! Acclaimed stand-up Janine Harouni has had more than 150 million views of her stand-up online. Her debut on BBC’s Live at the Apollo became one of the most-watched in the show’s history, amassing over 30 million views. Twice nominated for the Edinburgh Comedy Award, Janine’s show Man’oushe – performed at 8.5 months pregnant – toured internationally, selling thousands of tickets across the UK, India, Dubai, LA and New York. Her latest show This Is What You Waited For premiered at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe before transferring to a two week run at London’s Soho Theatre and launching a new international tour across the UK, North America and Europe. Micky Overman is a Dutch comedian based in London, who has become one of the most exciting names on the UK comedy circuit. Her latest show “Hold On” has toured internationally to critical acclaim and sold out numerous venues, including Amsterdam’s prestigious Royal Theatre Carré. Her podcast Thank F*** For That* with Sarah Keyworth and her own social media sketches have garnered millions of views. Think again! Centre 59 Theatre Week is your chance to go behind the scenes and explore how to create stories for the stage. Build Your Own Week This week is all about trying something new and unlocking your potential. Designed for people who have little to no experience in theatre, each day you’ll get to choose from a menu of practical workshops in areas such as: Action & Stunts (Stagecraft & Combat): Learn about physical timing, choreography, and fight-work used in action scenes. Creating Characters (Improvisation): Learn to think on your feet and build characters from scratch. Writing the Script (Script & Development): Bring your own real-life stories and ideas to the page. Movement (Physical Theatre & Dance): Get active and learn how to use music and movement to command a room. Backstage (Set design / directing): Get interactive tips and behind-the-scenes insights from working industry professionals that make theatre a magical experience. What you’ll get: A hands-on taste of acting, writing, devising and directing. A welcoming space to meet new people and collaborate. Direct coaching from expert mentors who know how to build your skills. A confidence boost that will help you speak up and hold any room. Who it’s for: You don’t need to be a ‘theatre kid’ to fit in here. Whether you’ve only ever done a bit of drama at school or are trying this for the very first time, everyone starts from scratch. There are no auditions to worry about, just come willing to get stuck in! Please note: To keep things fair for absolute beginners, this project is not open to anyone currently or recently undertaking intensive vocational performing arts training. (This could include CAT programs, associations with professional training schools, or performing at a high grade level.) About Centre 59 Centre 59 is an accessible space and entry point for young people to the artform of storytelling in theatre and the performing arts. Core to Centre 59 is the mission to build young artists who learn to share their own stories through a programme of writing, acting, directing and producing. Centre 59 is a creative partnership from Roundhouse and 59% Productions, spearheaded by Roundhouse Associate Artistic Director Daniel Kaluuya. With Director Evelyn Duah and Associate Director Louie Keen. Information for Parents: This project is an affordable, fully supervised summer holiday programme. It is designed to keep young people socially connected and engaged. Our team of professional facilitators create a safe environment where teamwork and real-world confidence are prioritised over theatrical perfection. Essential info: Ages: 18-25 Times: 9.30am–4pm (A full day of active, structured engagement) Location: Backstage Studio at Roundhouse, Camden. Price: £20 for the entire week (financial support available) How to join: Enter the lottery Due to high demand, places in this project will be assigned via random lottery selection of all eligible participants. To enter the lottery, fill in our online form using the ‘apply’ button at the top of this page by Wed 1 July, 10am. To enter you will need to: Fit the eligibility criteria Be aged 18-25 Be available for the full week (Monday – Friday, 9.30am-4pm) Successful entries will be notified on Monday 6 July. WHO IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR A PLACE? This project is not open to anyone who has currently, or recently, taken part in any vocational or intensive performing arts training. (This could include CAT programs, associations with professional training schools, or performing at a high grade level.) This is to help us ensure the project is accessible to those who have not experienced similar projects or training before. Previous year’s participants cannot take part in the same age group again. Last year’s 15-17s participants can enter the ballot if they are applying to the ages 18-25 programme for the first time. I’M NOT SURE I CAN AFFORD TO TAKE PART… If you need help to pay for things like project fees, transport or childcare, we can help. Find out how you can get support. If you are using a bursary to pay for the project, please ensure you arrange this with the Advice Base with plenty of time before the start of the project. I HAVE ADDITIONAL NEEDS. WHAT SUPPORT IS AVAILABLE? We are committed to supporting D/deaf, disabled and neurodiverse young people, those with medical conditions, access requirements or any lived experience that may require adaptation, support or sensitivity. If there is anything you would like to let us (our youth workers, tutors or staff) know that will support your enjoyment and access, you can do so by emailing us at advicebase@roundhouse.org.uk, and we will contact you to discuss further how to best support your engagement. This two-evening course is for aspiring audio editors, producers, and engineers aged 18–25 who already have some experience with Ableton Live and want to build confidence using more advanced workflows in a professional studio environment. Through guided workshops and practical exercises, you’ll explore how Ableton Live is used across real-world music and audio production settings. You’ll develop your editing, mixing, and production techniques while learning new ways to approach creative and technical workflows within the DAW. By the end of the course, you’ll leave with a completed piece of audio you’ve mixed or edited in Ableton Live, alongside a stronger understanding of the software and greater confidence in your own practice. gig.title: BARRENS
gig.pageText: BARRENS | The Grace Navigation Toggle Home About What’s On Hire Contact Instagram Twitter BARRENS The Grace, London Thu.20.Aug.26 BUY TICKETS Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Date: Thu 20th August 2026 Doors Open: 19:00 On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £10 Tickets are now available for BARRENS at The Grace! An explosive night of post rock and heavy guitar music lands in London on August 20 at The Grace, Islington. Gothenburg/Malmö-based post rock power trio Barrens return with Corpse Lights, the band’s second full-length release following their 2020 debut Penumbra. Five years in the making, Corpse Lights sees Barrens strike a balance between light and dark; beauty and brutality; the calm and the chaos. Recorded and produced by Kristofer Jönson and mixed and mastered by Cult of Luna’s Magnus Lindberg, shimmering synthesizers and sprawling guitars lead the charge propelled by drums and percussion, with space, silence and atmosphere as another instrument. The result is Corpse Lights, a collection of nine pieces that guide us through five years of highs and lows without ever needing to say a word. Gothenburg 4-piece Blessings merges disparate ends of heavy guitar music into a cohesive sound, drowned in elements of hardcore, punk, crust and noise rock, with a sound that reminds of At The Drive In and Converge. The band members come from a DIY punk/hardcore background, having paid their dues in hard touring bands like Anchor, Scraps of Tape, Obstruktion, Amalthea and Gamla Pengar. Saloni is a groundbreaking British-Asian singer-songwriter blending Pop, R&B, and Bollywood while performing in over 10 languages. She stands among the first UK artists to incorporate multiple South Asian languages into original music, shaping a distinct global fusion sound. As seen on BBC Sunday Morning Live and TV9, she has been recognised for both her artistry and cultural impact. BBC describes her as having a “voice of an absolute angel,” while NOTION praises her “cultural richness and powerful narratives…a rising force to watch.” Fame Magazine highlights her as “a fresh wave of cultural vitality and feminine force,” capturing the energy she brings to modern music. By blending languages, cultures, and contemporary global production, Saloni represents the underrepresented and champions South Asian stories on international stages. She is emerging as one of the defining voices of the next wave of Global South Asian music. For more events, check out what’s on here. Elias Alexander is a multi-instrumentalist, producer, and songwriter whose work swells from the intersection of traditional music, electronic production, and songwriting. Elias’s live shows take audiences on an unexpected journey that elicits everything from wild dancing to tears, while he alternates between bagpipes, fiddle, guitar, whistles, keyboards, and percussion, and uses Ableton Live to loop, sample, and build energy. gig.title: BE N!CE
gig.pageText: BE N!CE | The Grace Navigation Toggle Home About What’s On Hire Contact Instagram Twitter BE N!CE The Grace, London Sat.19.Sep.26 BUY TICKETS Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Date: Sat 19th September 2026 Doors Open: 19:00 On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £12 Tickets are now available for BE N!CE at The Grace! BE N!CE are a London-based punk band who have spent just over three years becoming one of the UK’s most compelling live acts — and they’re only getting started. Formed in late 2022, the four-piece have built their reputation show by show, driven by a DIY ethos, an anything-goes attitude, and music that balances absurdist humour with genuinely biting social commentary. Their genre-bending debut EP WHERE AM I? announced them as a band with something to say and the charisma to make people listen. Loud Women called them “unbridled, vivacious 21st century punk”at the sold-out EP release show; ThePunkSite gave it five stars; RTE came calling. The record explores personal struggle, social injustice, and the sheer absurdity of modern life — and does it without ever taking itself too seriously. Consisting of Pol Mills (vocals, they/them), Emily Harris (bass, she/her), Alex McIntosh (drums, he/him), and Brett Lee (guitar, he/him), BE N!CE have a chemistry that’s undeniable live. Over 80 shows across England, Germany, and Belgium have honed them into a tight, explosive unit — but one that still feels spontaneous and utterly alive on stage. They’ve been shortlisted for Kerrang’s 2025 The Deal and competed in No Sleep Til Hellfest 2024. In 2025 they played Loud Women Festival and Attitude Festival; in April 2026 they opened the main stage at Manchester Punk Festival to a crowd of 300-400 — the most high-profile set of their career to date. Rebellion Festival, Bearded Theory, Beware The Banshees in Utrecht, and more are still ahead of them this summer. Now BE N!CE are stepping into a new chapter. New single GREEN BURIAL — the first taste of their forthcoming EP, due this September — is one of their most ambitious tracks to date: an eco-conscious punk riot with elements of nu-metal and alt-rock, built around a satirical and darkly funny premise. With a festival summer ahead, a UK and European tour in the pipeline, and an EP that promises to push their sound further than ever, they’re proving that the best is still to come. With twelve Number 1 country singles and two Number 1 country albums to her name, Laura Aston has become one of the UK’s brightest stars in modern country music. Her acclaimed release The Patsy Cline Songbook made history by dominating six of the Top 10 spots on the iTunes Country Charts — a testament to both her powerhouse vocals and her ability to connect deeply with audiences through timeless storytelling. In 2022, Laura made international waves when she became the first international country artist to win the Golden Pick Award in association with the legendary Bluebird Café in Nashville — a milestone that underscored her growing influence on the global country scene. With a rapidly expanding fanbase — boasting over 500,000 followers on TikTok and more than 300,000 on Facebook — Laura’s music continues to reach listeners far and wide. Her songs rack up thousands of streams each month, with over 7,000 monthly listeners on Spotify, and her live performances are known for their authenticity, warmth, and connection. After selling out her first-ever headline show in 2021, Laura and her band have been relentlessly touring the UK, bringing her heartfelt songs and country spirit to venues across the nation — always drawing in a devoted crowd. Her fans’ loyalty runs deep, following her wherever the music takes her. With her undeniable talent, genuine love for her fans, and a voice that captures the soul of country music, Laura Aston is a rising force who continues to bridge Nashville roots with British heart. gig.title: PLAIINS
gig.pageText: PLAIINS | The Grace Navigation Toggle Home About What’s On Hire Contact Instagram Twitter PLAIINS The Grace, London Fri.02.Oct.26 BUY TICKETS Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Date: Fri 2nd October 2026 Doors Open: 19:00 Supported By: HONEYBADGER On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £18 Tickets are now available for PLAIINS at The Grace! Imagine this: you’re standing at the train tracks and a freight train loaded with a bunch of cheeky daredevils comes at you full throttle. Someone’s half hanging out the open carriage, reaching out an arm for you to hold on to – inviting you to hop on for the ride of your life. That’s what it feels like to be thrown into the sonic world of PLAIINS. Founded during the pandemic that held the globe in a standstill by frontman Chris, the Brit and his two German bandmates create a moving sound that’s informed by their deep love for alternative, punk and indie. Naturally, their 2025 debut album HAPPY FACES is full of playful riffs and dancey grooves – paired with witty lyrics that manage to talk about social issues and all-too- human struggles without ever taking themselves too seriously. Inspiration for the trio comes from bands like Queens Of The Stone Age, IDLES, Viagra Boys and Fontaines D.C., but also from personal life, politics and pop culture. On lead single ROW SHE SAID, for example, singer Chris draws from his experience with the aftermath of Brexit and the rise of right-wing, nationalist politics both in his home country, the UK, and in his adopted home Germany. Set to the background of heavy hitting, hard riffs and driving verses, this is an example of the more serious moments on the album. It shows a band that believes in the importance of taking a clear stance. Contrasting, the playfully teasing SPORTS BAR pokes light-hearted fun at long nights watching football games at the local pubs, a tradition that is ever-present both in the UK and Germany. The shout-along chorus with a groove reminiscing of The Hives at their greatest puts you right there, arm over shoulder with your best mates, shouting at the TV hung above the bar. PLAIINS is not a band that limits itself to any one genre or topic. Still, their sonic identity is clear cut and recognisable. Even though they just released their debut album, they already made a name for themselves as one of the most exciting up-and-coming bands. Not least because of their ferocious power-washer of a live show that leaves no body unmoved, whether at their headline shows or on tour with Press Club, LEAP or Itchy. So stop standing around and hop on already, mate! For more events, check out what’s on here. Brooke Law’s debut album is a bold statement – anchored by lead singles ‘Real’, ‘Big World’ and the new ‘Freak On’, she invites us to strip away the noise of modern life and stand tall in our own truth. From provocative rock to soulful confessionals, this is music as both challenge and comfort. A challenge to a world growing dangerously artificial. Her powerful voice, akin to rock icons yet wholly her own, blends grit and grace cueing to the core on an album that is both defiant and soulful. With influences ranging from Janis Joplin to Alanis Morissette, Brooke’s voice shifts from vulnerable whispers to defiant roars. Supported by Gibson guitars, who have made her an Epiphone Ambassador, Brooke Law is known for bringing energy and power to her live performances, both solo and with her band. She has performed at various festivals including C2C Festival, The Long Road Festival and Black Deer Festival to name a few. Brooke gets regular radio coverage through the BBC, Absolute Radio, Country Line Radio & TV, London Live TV and others as well as regular mentions in the music press. The full album ‘Naked Heart’ will land in Autumn 2025, with Brooke’s UK band tour commencing February 2026 followed by another band tour later in the year in September. Growing up in a musical family in Húsavík, he began releasing raw, early demos that led to his breakout single, “Forest Fires,” which is now streamed over 90 million times. His music draws from influences such as Bon Iver and Adrianne Lenker, blending gentle folk, ambient textures, and emotional honesty. After years of living in Reykjavík, Axel has returned to his hometown, where he continues to craft reflective, heartfelt songs – including new releases like singles “Nowhere” (December 19th 2025), “In The Grass” (January 30th 2026) and his upcoming EP, Fleeing the Shore set for April 24th 2026. gig.pageText: BLACK PONTIAC | The Grace Navigation Toggle Home About What’s On Hire Contact Instagram Twitter BLACK PONTIAC The Grace, London Fri.16.Oct.26 BUY TICKETS Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Date: Fri 16th October 2026 Doors Open: 19:00 On Sale: Tickets Open Price: £15 Tickets are now available for BLACK PONTIAC at The Grace! Black Pontiac bio Black Pontiac is a band born out of tension. Emerging from an underground DIY community they helped reshape in the wake of the pandemic, the Vancouver, BC quartet has been walking a careful line ever since; balancing grit, glam, garage rock edge and indie-pop hooks. Drawing from acts such as Cage the Elephant and The Clash, their sound thrives in the push and pull, and with an energetic live show, an enthusiastic cult following, over 10 millions streams on Spotify, as well as several tours, festival appearances, and support slots for acts like lovelytheband and Peach Pit under their belt, the band is poised to turn up the tension even higher with a new project coming June 2026: A Danger to Himself and Others, their 2nd full length LP, available now everywhere. The record dives headfirst into the chaos and contradictions that have come to define Black Pontiac; a reckless, anxious, swaggering, and tender collection of songs grappling with the performance of danger as a coping mechanism, the fear of falling apart, and the desperate attempt to carve out a sense of joy and belonging in the mess. Sunfish bio Sunfish is an Alternative Rock band from Salt Lake City, Utah. They fit anywhere from metal to pop with a unique sound coined by Utah venue Velour Music Gallery’s owner Corey Fox, as “glitch grunge.” Carter Sears (22), guitar and vocals has helmed Sunfish since its inception. He is joined on stage by Courtney Lane on keys and backing vocals, Mikkel Erickson on drums and recently Avery Davis on bass. Sunfish loves to be on the road, touring and/or opening for bands like Dead Poets Society, Arlie, Friday Pilots Club , IDKHow and Bad Flower. A new EP drops spring 2026, with its first single JACKPOT available on streaming platforms now and the full EP available for purchase in the website shop. The Jackpot release is suported by a Western States tour in March with more tour dates to be announced soon. As always with all things Fishy, best to catch them live. Camille Jansen is an independent French-British artist that resides between LA and Paris. From a youthful age, Jansen recalls household artists Bob Dylan and Leonard Cohen being the soundtrack to most road trips. When curiosity got the best of her, Camille’s passion for storytelling grew larger and with that came her unrivaled talent for songwriting. Earning support from the likes of Grazia and Earmilk, Camille made her debut back in 2021 and has since amassed millions of streams across streaming platforms. More recently, Camille has gained support from BBC 6music, Radio X, Clash Magazine, Crack Magazine, and Far Out Magazine, for her debut album ‘The Loose Screws‘. Whilst also supporting Babe Rainbow for their East Coast tour. For Camille music isn’t the only form of expression, her sense of style plays a huge role in her delivery. Pushing her love for vintage fashion and sustainability to the forefront of her image, Camille has gained further recognition from platforms including L’Officiel and Paris Fashion Week, and has worked with Chanel, Acne Studios, Celine and Chloe. In 2025 you can hear Camille Jansen’s very own rendition of On A Plain by Nirvana as part A Tribute to Nirvana – The Songs of MTV Unplugged, and she’ll be featuring on Babe Rainbow’s forthcoming album slipper imp a and shakaerator, who she’ll be touring Australia & New Zealand with through March and April. Abbie McCarthy is an award-winning broadcaster who has championed artists on the live scene for the last decade. This club night has provided early shows for so many brilliant artists over the years, including the likes of Sam Fender, Olivia Dean & many more. Catch your new favourite artists performing as part of Abbie McCarthy’s Good Karma Club this July! Leonie Biney Leonie Biney has a talent for tapping into universal feelings of vulnerability. Her poetic, observational lyrics and bedroom pop aesthetic blend seamlessly into a broader indie/alternative sound. Her debut EP, “It Could Have Been Nice,” was released Summer of 2024 alongside a sold-out headline show at Folklore Hoxton; following this Leonie supported Rachel Chinouriri on her UK tour. Gianna With a writing style that carries the wisdom and depth of someone far beyond her years, 23-year-old Gianna’s lyrics are full of enigmatic metaphors and clever wordplay. Not just introducing herself as a musician but mapping out the world that shaped her: Gianna is finding influence in everything from UK jungle and downtempo to Albanian folk. Moloney Born in Ballina, County Mayo, Moloney left home to move to London at aged just 18. His songs tell stories of loss, family, leaving home and finding yourself. Moloney’s story in music has already built an online following and army of young folk music fans discovering his voice and lyricism. Modern and alternative, his unique brand of folk music is nuanced and emotive. For more events, check out what’s on here. gig.title: JACK BOTTS
gig.pageText: JACK BOTTS | The Grace Navigation Toggle Home About What’s On Hire Contact Instagram Twitter JACK BOTTS The Grace, London Sat.03.Oct.26 Sold Out Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Date: Sat 3rd October 2026 Doors Open: 19:00 On Sale: Sold Out * Sorry, this event is sold out Price: £20 Tickets are now available for JACK BOTTS at The Grace! Jack Botts has built a dedicated global audience over the past five years, with his laid-back yet deeply personal brand of surf-folk resonating worldwide. His heartfelt storytelling and breezy melodies have led to over 100 million streams and headlining over 80 shows across North America, Europe, the UK, Australia, and New Zealand in 2024. Speaking about Home Days, Jack shared: “I’ve spent most of my 20s constantly on the move, traveling and touring all over the place—and I’ve loved every minute of it! But early in 2024, I had a rare window of time back in Australia. It had been a while since I just stopped, sat down, and fully embraced home. I didn’t realize how much I’d missed the little things—surf checks, the sound of native birds, quiet mornings at local cafés, time in the water, the sun, the silence, and of course, moments with friends and family. It felt so nice. Right then and there, I knew these days are the best. Home days.” His easy-listening style continues to captivate audiences, earning him support slots alongside Tash Sultana, JP Saxe, Ocean Alley, and Boy & Bear, while also lighting up major festival stages like Cigale Festival (CAN), Boardmasters (UK), Maifeld Derby (GER), Electric Castle (ROM), and Latitude Festival (UK). Now, with Home Days, he invites listeners to pause, breathe, and appreciate the beauty of the everyday. For more events, check out what’s on here.
